# Session with Jade

> One to one performance, presence and media coaching for actors, musicians, public figures, influencers and the managers and publicists who represent them. Run by Jade Matthew in London, in person and online worldwide.

Jade Matthew is a working actress with twenty years of screen and radio credits across the BBC, HBO, Netflix, Channel 4, ITV and Sky, and a BBC Audio Drama Award. She lectures at LAMDA and is a clinical hypnotherapist and Master NLP Practitioner. Her coaching combines performance training, communication and psychology through the ICOP Method (Identify, Clear, Own, Perform).

## What she helps with
- Press junkets, interviews, long lead profiles and live television
- Album press, stage talk and documentary interviews for musicians
- On camera presence and personal brand coaching for influencers and creators
- Hostile questioning, awards speeches, podcasts and live streams
- Performance anxiety, stage fright and imposter feelings, as coaching rather than medical treatment

## Ways to work together
- Press and campaign preparation: fixed fee per person, agreed in advance
- Roster retainer for managers, agents and publicists: days per month, short notice availability
- Personal brand coaching: blocks of six to ten sessions
- The confidence work underneath: longer term work on anxiety about being seen
Fees are on application after a free 20 minute call. All work is confidential and clients are never named.
